headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalStarRetry.flatExit_variation
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length),
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    ∀ (b : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.BalancedVertices r c U L) (h : ℕ)
      (hstar : 0 < Math115.PhysicalStarRetry.starMass r c U L hr hc b)
      (fallback : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (J : ℕ),
      OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
            (Math115.PhysicalStarRetry.flatExit r c U L hr hc b h fallback J))
          (Math115.PhysicalStarRetry.targetLaw r c U L hr hc b hstar) ≤
        (1 - Math115.PhysicalStarRetry.successProbability r c U L hr hc b) ^ J +
          ↑J * Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic h

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalStarRetry.flatExit_variation_of_edge
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length),
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    ∀ (hL : 7 ≤ L) (b : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.BalancedVertices r c U L) (h : ℕ)
      (entering : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L)
      (hbe :
        OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.physicalAdjacent r c U L (Math115.ReducedSmallChain.capacity r c U L) ⋯
          ↑b ↑entering)
      (J : ℕ),
      OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
            (Math115.PhysicalStarRetry.flatExit r c U L hr hc b h entering J))
          (Math115.PhysicalStarRetry.targetLaw r c U L hr hc b ⋯) ≤
        (1 - Math115.PhysicalRationalKernel.proposalRat OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance / 2) ^
            J +
          ↑J * Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic h

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalStarRetry.targetLaw_mass_cast
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (b : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.BalancedVertices r c U L)
  (hstar : 0 < Math115.PhysicalStarRetry.starMass r c U L hr hc b)
  (e : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L),
  ↑((Math115.PhysicalStarRetry.targetLaw r c U L hr hc b hstar).mass e) =
    Math115.ComputedReferenceTrace.referenceCross r c U L
        ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv r U hr) none)
        ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv c U hc) none) b e /
      ∑ f,
        Math115.ComputedReferenceTrace.referenceCross r c U L
          ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv r U hr) none)
          ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv c U hc) none) b f

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalStarRetry.flatExit_zero_star_variation
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length),
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    ∀ (b : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.BalancedVertices r c U L) (h : ℕ),
      Math115.PhysicalStarRetry.starMass r c U L hr hc b = 0 →
        ∀ (fallback : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (J : ℕ),
          OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
                (Math115.PhysicalStarRetry.flatExit r c U L hr hc b h fallback J))
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.pointLaw fallback) ≤
            ↑J * Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic h
